frame.goal: Cut a2web cold-start fetch latency below 400ms
frame.method: Hold a warm connection pool per host so TLS and first-byte cost are paid once per host rather than per fetch
assumptions: itm-0007 was falsified: parse is 38ms of a 1.9s cold start (2%); 1.4s is TLS handshake plus first-byte wait on the origin
The origins a2web fetches permit connection reuse
